clips.title: The story
paras: Goldshire's marshal faces threats on every road and mine. Marshal Dughan commands the Stormwind Army detachment there, but kobolds, gnolls, and bandits stretch his small garrison. He depends on independent adventurers to help protect the town and nearby farms.

Marshal Dughan directs Elwynn Forest's defense from Goldshire, outside the Lion's Pride Inn. Stormwind's soldiers are tied up elsewhere, while trouble grows in the woods. Kobolds crowd the mines, gnolls gather along the riverbanks, and highwaymen harass travelers on the King's Road. With too few footmen under his command, Dughan sends new recruits to reinforce outposts and scout dangerous ground.

Kobolds overrun Fargodeep and Jasperlode Mines, threatening Goldshire's mineral supply. West of town, Hogger's Riverpaw gnolls press against Westbrook Garrison. Eastward, Guard Thomas reports vicious murlocs killing patrols along the river. Dughan has too few soldiers to meet each threat, so he needs capable mercenaries to help contain them.
